cohort: 200 pregnant women at Jay Kaylon Hospital, Kota, Rajasthan, India, from December 2018 to August 2020, compared to 100 non-pregnant women; 56% were aged 21-25, 70% were from urban areas, 63.5% had vegetarian diets, and 49.5% were primigravida.
finding: A statistically significant rise in lipid profile values was found during pregnancy compared to non-pregnant women, and higher lipid levels were associated with gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: 69.5% of women delivered vaginally while 30.5% delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Birth weight <2.5 kg was observed in 27 fetuses.
